name: Kitano Takako
source:
Mother of Kojirou and wife of Kenji.

She is a cheerful, vivacious, and refreshing woman who works as a store keeper at “Toy no Kitano” (now “Hobby Shop Kitano”) on the way to Haiyori Elementary School. She is frightening when she gets angry. Every elementary school boy baptized her front store with candy trash and empty capsules.

Her favorite dish is curry filled with vegetables from her family's farm. However, his son and his friends do not like it, saying, “It tastes good, but there are too many vegetables.

[from [url=http://autobahn69.jp/Autobahn/lovemilf.html] official site]
